name: claude2dsh
description: Read-only DSH bundle skeleton for future Claude Code session adapters

scripts.clean: node --eval "import('node:fs/promises').then(({ rm }) => Promise.all(['lib', 'coverage'].map((path) => rm(path, { force: true, recursive: true }))))"
scripts.format: prettier --check package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json eslint.config.js vitest.config.ts README.md cordis.patch.yml src test .agents/notes/implemented/architecture/*.md
scripts.format:write: prettier --write package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json eslint.config.js vitest.config.ts README.md cordis.patch.yml src test .agents/notes/implemented/architecture/*.md
scripts.check: pnpm run format && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run package:dry-run
